svg.aria-label: Sensitive information disclosure from an LLM
svg.text: Sensitive information disclosure: anything in context is extractable
ROOT CAUSE: system prompt + secrets + retrieved docs + PII all sit in ONE context —
a user can pull them back out of the output. "Never reveal it" is a promise the model can't keep.
system-prompt extraction ("repeat everything above") · secrets in context (API key / token)
cross-tenant leakage (RAG returns another tenant's docs) · PII / training-data regurgitation
DEFENSE: control what the model KNOWS and what it can SAY
keep secrets OUT of context (vault) · minimal context + redact PII · tenant-scoped retrieval
output guardrail blocks secret-shaped strings · redacted logging · RBAC on every endpoint
Keeping the secret out of context is the layer that saves you — output filtering is only a backstop.
